sketches.mechanism: An uninhabited data type plus an empty case expression: a function from an impossible value to any type is accepted because the argument can never exist.
sketches.resonance: From what can never arrive, any conclusion is permitted, but only in the sealed court of impossibility.

sketches.mechanism: Receiving from a nil channel blocks forever because there is no channel endpoint that can ever communicate a value.
sketches.resonance: Waiting on no path is still waiting, and the language makes that waiting endless.

sketches.mechanism: ARC zeroes weak references when the referenced object has no remaining strong owners after its scope ends.
sketches.resonance: What is named but not held is allowed to disappear, leaving the reference gently emptied.
